items.name: corbits-theme
items.title: Corbits theme
items.description: Corbits brand tokens and base layer: color, radius and type, light and dark.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn
items.description: Tailwind-aware className merge.

items.name: data-port
items.title: Data port
items.description: Pluggable data-provider seam: components declare what they need, the host decides how it is fetched.

items.name: tanstack-data-port
items.title: TanStack data port
items.description: Default DataPort backed by TanStack Query. Swap it for any other implementation of DataPort.

items.name: use-collection-state
items.title: useCollectionState
items.description: Collapses a DataPort collection into loading / error / empty / ready, so lists and grids reuse the branching instead of copying it out of data-table.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: formatRelativeTime
items.description: "3 min ago" from an ISO timestamp, localised. `now` is a parameter so the output is a pure function of its inputs.

items.name: now-item
items.title: NowItem
items.description: The attention model behind the inbox: gate | mail, a fixed priority, a free-string classification, plus sorting and priority grouping.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat message model
items.description: Agent-agnostic conversation model: a message is ordered parts (text, reasoning, tool, file), not a string plus a tool array, so a turn's true order survives.

items.name: command-registry
items.title: Command registry
items.description: Lets a page contribute palette commands without the app root importing every page. A useState array behind a context — no lifecycle hooks, no priorities, no middleware.

items.name: schedule
items.title: Schedule model
items.description: An interval plus a time of day, not cron: everything the scheduling UI can express is representable, and it reads back in words from one place.

items.name: workflow-run
items.title: Workflow run status
items.description: Run status, identity and timing — labels, badge and dot tones, terminal/active predicates and attention ordering. Deliberately says nothing about run contents.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Action button. Primary is Breakthrough Orange and should appear once per screen.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input with token-driven focus ring and aria-invalid styling.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Surface container with header, title, description and footer parts.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal surface on Radix — centred, or pinned to the left or right edge as a side sheet. Focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus restoration come from the primitive.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts with horizontal overflow handling.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Table bound to a DataPort — loading, error and empty states included. Ships the TanStack port as the working default; swap it by providing any other DataPort.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact status/label chip. Tones are semantic; `accent` is the one orange tone and should stay rare.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App rail: labelled nav sections, active state, counts and a collapsed icon-only mode. Composable parts — header and footer are the slots for an environment badge and a tenant selector.

items.name: tenant-selector
items.title: Tenant selector
items.description: Which tenant/workspace the app is pointed at, as an ARIA listbox. Tenants and selection arrive as props.

items.name: top-bar
items.title: Top bar
items.description: The row above the page: title or breadcrumb trail on the left, page-contributed controls on the right.

items.name: notifications-bell
items.title: Notifications bell
items.description: Bell with an unread count and the panel body as a slot. Renders a count and opens a panel; it never fetches or marks anything read.

items.name: context-strip
items.title: Context strip and pills
items.description: What the app is currently on: one line for the active context, removable pills for the set attached to the next action.

items.name: boot-screen
items.title: Boot screen
items.description: The screen before the app: brand, one centered status line, a quiet corner detail. Fills its positioned parent; the message is the accessible name.

items.name: reconnecting-overlay
items.title: Reconnecting overlay
items.description: Full-viewport cover for a live app that lost its connection. Same surface as first load; the host must mark the app root inert while it is open.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A titled block: heading, optional description, count and controls, then content. One component for page headers and sections — `as` sets the heading level.

items.name: now-cards
items.title: Now section and cards
items.description: The attention band at the top of the inbox: an urgency eyebrow, a count in words, a collapsed mode, and the highest-priority items as cards.

items.name: command-queue
items.title: Command queue
items.description: The dense attention queue under the Now strip. DataPort-backed, so it paginates; its four states come from useCollectionState, the same machine the data table uses.

items.name: mail-detail
items.title: Mail detail
items.description: The reading pane for one message: sender, enrichment badges, body, related reference chips and actions. Content only — it renders into a drawer or a two-pane layout.

items.name: status-dot
items.title: Status dot
items.description: Liveness marker carrying its own accessible name. Three tones, because those are the fills that clear 3:1 at 8px — the badge beside it names the state.

items.name: intake-form
items.title: Intake form
items.description: The inputs a run asks for, rendered from a field list. Fully controlled, so the same form backs a one-off run and a saved schedule.

items.name: workflow-dock
items.title: Workflow dock
items.description: The active-runs strip: what is in flight and which of it is waiting on you. Renders nothing when nothing is running.

items.name: workflow-catalog
items.title: Workflow catalog
items.description: What the user can start, as offering cards with favourites and a slot for the run panel. DataPort-backed, so its states come from useCollectionState.

items.name: run-once-flow
items.title: Run-once flow
items.description: Start one run, now, with these inputs — no recurrence, nothing saved. Submits through a real form, so Enter and required-field handling come from the browser.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval card
items.description: The human decision surface for a blocked action: what will happen, every argument it will run with, and approve / reject / always-allow.

items.name: message-bubble
items.title: Message bubble
items.description: One message. Only the user's side is a filled bubble — a long agent reply reads better on the page ground than in a tinted block.

items.name: tool-narrative
items.title: Tool narrative
items.description: What the agent did, as one openable line. Collapsed even while running so the answer is not pushed off screen; a failed call opens itself.

items.name: subagent-dock
items.title: Subagent dock
items.description: One row per task the agent delegated: state, elapsed, and the helper's own tool narrative. Turn-scoped and prop-driven, not a DataPort collection. Renders nothing when nobody was delegated to.

items.name: activity-block
items.title: Activity block
items.description: The agent's thinking, folded away in a native <details> so disclosure semantics, keyboard behaviour and find-in-page come from the browser.

items.name: agent-turn
items.title: Agent turn
items.description: One agent reply in the order it happened — thought, did, said. Parts render in model order rather than grouped by kind.

items.name: quick-reply-chips
items.title: Quick reply chips
items.description: Suggested replies as a labelled list, so a screen reader announces how many there are before reading them.

items.name: chat-input
items.title: Chat input
items.description: The composer: Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks, IME composition is excluded, and send becomes stop while the agent replies.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat thread
items.description: The transcript. Messages arrive as props because a streaming conversation is host-owned live state, not a cached collection; it pins to the bottom only when the reader is already there.

items.name: chat-panel
items.title: Chat panel
items.description: The conversation frame — header with agent identity, body, composer footer. Parts, because one frame serves the full page, the dock and the floating panel.

items.name: chat-shell
items.title: Chat shells
items.description: Launcher button, floating panel and docked bar. All complementary regions, not dialogs — the page stays usable behind them.

items.name: thread-list
items.title: Thread list
items.description: Past conversations, DataPort-backed — paginated server-owned data, which is exactly what the transcript is not.

items.name: thread-switcher
items.title: Thread switcher
items.description: Names the conversation you are in and reveals the rest on demand — the answer a docked bar or floating panel has no room for a list to give. Wraps ThreadList in a popover with a collapsed trigger, Escape, outside-click and focus return.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: Filterable, keyboard-driven action list on the ARIA combobox pattern. Subsequence matching, not scored fuzzy — a palette that reorders under your cursor beats muscle memory.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: A dialog whose only content is a Command, plus the ⌘K hook. Open state is a prop, because the host is opening it from a button and a shortcut anyway.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting. role=switch on a button, not a styled checkbox — a switch takes effect now, a checkbox implies a form you still have to submit.

items.name: settings-panel
items.title: Settings panel
items.description: The frame every settings group shares — heading, controls, and a save control only where saving means something. One shell, not one component per group.

items.name: toggle-list
items.title: Toggle list
items.description: A list of things that are on or off — tools, auto-approved actions, preferences, brief sources. Each row's description is tied to its switch.

items.name: dial
items.title: Dial
items.description: A continuous setting on a native range input, so keyboard, screen-reader and touch support come from the browser. The value is always visible.

items.name: managed-list
items.title: Managed list
items.description: A collection the user curates — pinned items, connected accounts. Remove is labelled with the item's name, never a row of identical "Remove" buttons.

items.name: recurrence-input
items.title: Recurrence input
items.description: How often something runs. Controls that do not apply are absent rather than disabled, and it reads back what it is set to in the same words the list will use.

items.name: run-now-button
items.title: Run-now button
items.description: Fire something off immediately — send the brief, run a schedule early. Confirms in its own label and refuses to claim success when the promise rejects.

items.name: schedule-flow
items.title: Schedule flow
items.description: Create or edit a repeating job — name, recurrence, and the same intake fields a one-off run uses. One component; `onDelete` is what makes it an edit.

items.name: schedule-list
items.title: Schedule list
items.description: The user's repeating jobs, each saying when it next runs. The pause switch is on the row, not behind an edit screen.

items.name: provider-mark
items.title: Provider mark
items.description: Which service an action goes through, as a monogram with a slot for the host's own brand artwork. This registry ships no third-party logos.

items.name: corbits-mark
items.title: Corbits mark
items.description: The Corbits mountain mark. Fills with currentColor, so it needs no dark-mode variant; path and viewBox are exported for non-SVG consumers.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder for content that has not arrived. Always aria-hidden — render a status line beside it, not six announced grey boxes.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Nothing to show, said properly: title, reason, and the way out. Shared so every list stops growing its own centred stack.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated number
items.description: A number that counts to its new value. requestAnimationFrame rather than a motion dependency, tabular-nums so it cannot shove the layout.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Prev/Next around a "Page X of Y" legend for numbered server-side paging — the counterpart to the DataPort's append-as-you-go load-more.

items.name: view-toggle
items.title: View toggle
items.description: Grid or rows, as a segmented control. Pressed-button toggles rather than radios, and each carries a text label.

items.name: progress-checklist
items.title: Progress checklist
items.description: Steps and how far along they are. Each row states its status in words, not only by icon colour; the list announces politely as steps land.

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm button
items.description: A small destructive action behind a second click. Disarms on blur as well as on a timer, so a primed button is never left behind.

items.name: file-input
items.title: File input
items.description: A drop zone that is also a button that is also a real file input — sr-only, never display:none, so it stays keyboard reachable.

items.name: catalog-glyph
items.title: Catalog glyph
items.description: A deterministic decorative face for a catalog tile with no artwork. Drawn in currentColor, so it is correct in both themes for free.

items.name: sortable-table
items.title: Sortable table
items.description: A table you sort by clicking a header, with aria-sort on the active column. Client-side over rows you already hold — use DataTable when the data is paginated.

items.name: page-shell
items.title: Page shell
items.description: The frame a top-level page sits in: full height, one scroll container, one measure. Draws nothing — it is the page boundary, not a surface.

items.name: section-nav
items.title: Section nav
items.description: The in-page rail for a sectioned area, with its layout. Distinct from Sidebar: it lives in the content, scrolls horizontally when narrow, and has no surface.

items.name: list-detail
items.title: List / detail
items.description: Index left, open item right; on narrow screens the detail replaces the list, which is why the close callback is required rather than optional.

items.name: onboarding-tour
items.title: Onboarding tour
items.description: Dim the page, cut a hole around one element, explain it. The hole stays clickable and Escape always ends the tour.

items.name: whats-new
items.title: What's new
items.description: Release notes in three framings — inline section, requested dialog, unsolicited popup — sharing one entry renderer so they cannot drift.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Sonner toaster wired to the Corbits tokens. Mount once at the app root.

items.name: artifact
items.title: Artifact model
items.description: The projection an artifact viewer needs — id, title, kind, payload, provenance — plus the kind-to-form lookup you edit when you add a kind.

items.name: csv
items.title: CSV preview parser
items.description: RFC 4180 parsing sized for previewing a file in a tab: refuses oversized input, caps rows and columns, and reports when a file is not rectangular enough to tabulate.

items.name: artifact-notice
items.title: Artifact notice
items.description: The one place an artifact viewer says there is nothing to draw — and distinguishes still-being-written from genuinely empty.

items.name: csv-table
items.title: CSV table
items.description: CSV text as a table when the parse is rectangular, as raw text when it is not, and as a refusal when the file is too large.

items.name: compare-body
items.title: Comparison body
items.description: Two or more variants side by side with the verdict said in text, not only in colour, plus an optional score table.

items.name: research-body
items.title: Research body
items.description: A structured research brief: stat line, lead insight, themes, quotes and citations, with the working folded behind a native disclosure.

items.name: embed-body
items.title: Embed body
items.description: A third-party https URL in a narrowly-sandboxed frame, with the direct link always present because a blocked iframe fires no error.

items.name: artifact-body
items.title: Artifact body
items.description: One artifact drawn the way its kind implies — a switch over seven forms you own and edit, not a renderer registry.

items.name: artifact-gallery
items.title: Artifact gallery
items.description: A DataPort collection of artifacts as a grid or as rows, with real buttons for tiles and an explicit Load more.

items.name: add-artifact-dialog
items.title: Add artifact dialog
items.description: Add an artifact from a link, pasted text or files. A real tablist for the modes; the host owns persistence via one promise.

items.name: artifact-detail
items.title: Artifact detail
items.description: The frame one artifact is read in: a header that stays put, a wide scrolling stage, and a metadata rail that collapses when empty.

items.name: chart-palette
items.title: Chart palette
items.description: Series colour assigned by position and never cycled, over five contrast- and colour-vision-validated theme tokens, plus the fold-to-Other rule past five.

items.name: chart-geometry
items.title: Chart geometry
items.description: Round axis ticks from zero, linear scaling, straight-segment paths and compact number formatting — the arithmetic a chart does before it draws.

items.name: chart-frame
items.title: Chart frame
items.description: The frame every chart sits in: a figure caption that names it, a legend for two or more series, and the same numbers as a table one disclosure away.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: One value per category as horizontal bars — flat labels, one series colour, rounded only at the data end, axis always from zero.

items.name: time-series-chart
items.title: Time series chart
items.description: Up to five series over one shared axis — never two y-scales — with a crosshair readout reachable by pointer and by arrow key.

items.name: sparkline
items.title: Sparkline
items.description: A trend at the size of a word: no axes, scaled to its own range, with a required text summary because the shape has no other fallback.

items.name: stat-tile
items.title: Stat tile and grid
items.description: One number with its direction said in an arrow and in words, never colour alone; upIsGood is required because no default is right for cost and error metrics.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: The tab pattern with the parts people leave out: roving tabindex, arrow/Home/End keys, aria-controls both ways, and only the open panel mounted.

items.name: time-range
items.title: Time range
items.description: Presets and a custom window resolved to plain date bounds, with now passed in so the resolver is a pure function of its inputs.

items.name: time-range-control
items.title: Time range control
items.description: The window selector as a radiogroup — one-of-many, not six independent toggles — with native date fields revealed only for a custom range.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: A row of filters plus removable chips saying which are applied, because a forgotten filter is the usual reason a dashboard looks empty.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard shell
items.description: Title, one band of controls that scope every panel below, and the body — plus a loading state shaped like the dashboard so nothing jumps when it settles.

items.name: activity
items.title: Activity model
items.description: One thing that happened, plus day grouping that preserves the source order and drops unparseable timestamps rather than heading them Invalid Date.

items.name: activity-timeline
items.title: Activity timeline
items.description: A DataPort feed under real day headings — one component for a person history and a whole-workspace feed, since they differ only by request.

items.name: moment-walker
items.title: Moment walker
items.description: One moment at a time with the sequence beneath it as a listbox — arrow keys move the selection, not the focus, so a long run is not a long tab order.

items.name: count-table
items.title: Count table
items.description: A ranked tally where the number is the content and the bar behind it is the secondary encoding — the inverse of a bar chart, on purpose.

items.name: actor-summary
items.title: Actor summary
items.description: The header of an actor detail page: initials, headline numbers, and grants or teams as a real description list rather than a wall of chips.

items.name: dither-canvas
items.title: Dither canvas
items.description: An ordered-dither field that reacts to the pointer. Decorative and aria-hidden; draws exactly one frame under reduced motion, which the theme CSS cannot reach.

items.name: quote-card
items.title: Quote card
items.description: A quote rotated once per page load, never on a timer — text that swaps while you read it is what WCAG 2.2.2 prohibits. Quotes are yours.

items.name: login
items.title: Sign-in page
items.description: The two-column sign-in page: form column, decorative panel, provider buttons and an email form. Every outcome leaves through a callback — the block never authenticates.

items.name: access-notice
items.title: Access notice page
items.description: The page for someone signed in with nothing to see — awaiting an invitation or removed from a workspace. A specific state with a next step, not an empty dashboard.
